I'm filing two claims: DB-1 for disability and PF-3 for Paid Family Leave. The other five forms stay out. Each claim is a card for you to approve before it goes.

**What I'm filing**
- **DB-1, disability, 16 Nov 2026 to 10 Jan 2027 (8 weeks).** Dr. Okoye's certificate C-1 certifies these dates for the caesarean, and the certificate is Part B of this form. The benefit is 170.00 dollars a week, because 50% of your 1,640.00 average wage is 820.00 and the 170.00 cap applies. A 7-day waiting period applies, so payment starts on the eighth day (23 Nov).
- **PF-3, Paid Family Leave, 11 Jan to 7 Feb 2027 (4 weeks).** It starts the day after the certified disability ends, so there is no gap and no overlap. It ends on the same day as your HR leave request FM-1, so the claims and the 12 weeks of job-protected leave line up. At 67% of your wage it pays 1,098.80 dollars a week, under the 1,228.53 cap
